A Leaf’s Little Journey

Orien was settling down for a nap when a golden leaf landed on his nose. One little sneeze later, the orange cat beside him had met her new neighbour.

1
A Leaf’s Little Journey

The breeze carried the leaf into the little stream. The cat followed, looking back. Orien stretched and caught up. Together, they followed that little flash of gold.

2
A Leaf’s Little Journey

A twig between the stones held the little leaf still. The cat crouched by the water. Orien looked at the leaf, then at the branch holding it there.

3
A Leaf’s Little Journey

Orien gently lifted the twig. The leaf slipped free. The cat’s ears pricked up. She hurried two steps ahead, then stopped and waited for him.

4
A Leaf’s Little Journey

Under the bridge, the leaf disappeared. They waited, side by side. Then gold caught the sunlight. Orien’s tail began to sway. On they went, a little farther.

5
A Leaf’s Little Journey

Back beneath the tree, Orien made a little room. The cat curled beside him. No leaf tickled his nose now. Just the sound of the stream, and a soft, sleepy purr.
